SQL: WITH subquery AS (SELECT DISTINCT t1."原子编号" AS atom_id, t1."元素" AS element, t1."分子编号" AS molecule_id, t2."标签" AS label FROM "原子" AS t1 INNER JOIN "分子" AS t2 ON t1."分子编号" = t2."分子编号" WHERE t2."分子编号" = 'TR006') SELECT CAST(COUNT(CASE WHEN subquery.element = 'h' THEN subquery.atom_id ELSE NULL END) AS REAL) / (CASE WHEN COUNT(subquery.atom_id) = 0 THEN NULL ELSE COUNT(subquery.atom_id) END) AS ratio, subquery.label AS label FROM subquery AS subquery GROUP BY subquery.label
